Name: Peaches ReShade - An Aesthetic Preset
Author: SVpeaches
Description:
[center][/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/YROiVWS.png[/img]﻿﻿﻿﻿

[size=6][b]
[color=#ead1dc]Hello! ♡ [/color][/b][/size][/center]
[center]
[i]I was searching for a recolor that matched my preferences, but I couldn't find it, so I tried making my own preset.
I really loved how it turned out, so I decided to share it with the community.
I hope you like it too! ♥[/i]


[b][color=#f4cccc][u]Important[/u]:[/color][/b] This was made to be used along with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26027](CP) Dustbeauty's Stardew Foliage and Recolor[/url]﻿, which is basically [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4966]Dustbeauty's Foliage Redone[/url]﻿ with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Novaphene?gameId=1303]Novaphene[/url]﻿'s recolor. This is already a beautiful mod on its own, I highly recommend trying it before adding my preset. You can also try my preset without Novaphene's mod, but I guarantee you'll love what that mod brings! You can check the pictures to see﻿﻿ all these differences I mentioned. :)


─── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──


[color=#ead1dc][b][size=6]⭑ Installation Guide ⭑[/size][/b][/color][/center]

[center][b][size=3]Installing ReShade program[/size][/b]

[b][color=#f4cccc]﻿1.[/color][/b] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26027](CP) Dustbeauty's Stardew Foliage and Recolor[/url] and all of its requirements.

[b][color=#f4cccc]2.[/color][/b] Download ReShade [url=https://reshade.me/#download]in this link[/url].

[b][color=#f4cccc]3.[/color][/b] ﻿Run ReShade setup and pick Stardew Valley from the list.

[color=#f4cccc][b]4.[/b][/color] Select OpenGL.

[b][color=#f4cccc]5.[/color][/b] When asked which effects to install, make sure the ones below are marked:

[font=Courier New][size=2]"SweetFX by CeeJay.dk"
"qUINT by Marty McFly"
"Color effects by prod80"
[/size][/font]
[b][color=#f4cccc]6.[/color][/b] Finish the installation.


─── ⋆⋅☆⋅⋆ ──


[b][size=3]Setting up Peaches preset[/size][/b]

[b][color=#f4cccc]1.[/color][/b] After downloading the preset, move the file to Stardew Valley's folder:
[font=Courier New](...\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley)
[/font]
[color=#f4cccc][b]2.[/b][/color] Open the game and press "HOME" on your keyboard, this will open ReShade.

[color=#f4cccc][b]3.[/b][/color] Click on [url=https://i.imgur.com/tyxGCe6.png]"ReShadePreset" and choose "Peaches Preset"[/url]﻿ from the list.

[color=#f4cccc][b]4.[/b][/color] Press "HOME" again to close ReShade and you're good to go![/center]
